name: Cheese and Caramelised Onion Tart
subtitle: A savoury tart with sweet onions and mature cheddar
description: A crisp pastry shell filled with slowly softened onions, nutmeg-scented cream, egg yolks, and vegetarian cheddar, finished with chives.

ingredients.item: egg yolks (freeze the whites for another recipe
plain flour plus extra for dusting

instructions.text: Rub the cold butter cut into cubes into the plain flour plus extra for dusting until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs. Add the egg beaten and bring the mixture together into a dough.
Shape the dough into a flat disc, wrap or cover, and chill for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a wide pan. Add the onions (about 8) and cook gently for about 45 minutes, stirring occasionally, until deeply softened and caramelised.
Whisk the double cream with the pinch of grated nutmeg. Stir in the egg yolks (freeze the whites for another recipe and the mature vegetarian cheddar grated.
Preheat the oven to 400°F. Dust the work surface with the plain flour plus extra for dusting, roll out the dough, and line a tart tin. Trim the edge and chill briefly if the pastry becomes soft.
Line the pastry with baking paper and weights, then bake for 20 minutes. Remove the paper and weights and bake until the base is cooked through.
Spread the caramelised onions in the pastry shell and pour in the cream mixture. Bake at 350°F for about 25 minutes, until the filling is set and reaches 160°F at the center.
Cool slightly, then cut into slices and serve with chives finely sliced and extra mature vegetarian cheddar grated to serve (optional).
